bench-press-barbell.name: Bench Press (Barbell)
cues: Grip about 1.5× shoulder width, bar in the heel of the palm, thumbs around the bar.
Lower to the lower chest with elbows about 50° from the torso.
Press back up over the shoulders; feet flat, upper back on the bench.

incline-bench-press-dumbbell.name: Incline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
cues: Start with the dumbbells over the shoulders, palms toward your feet.
Lower until the elbows are just below the bench, wrists stacked over the elbows.
Press up and slightly in; keep the shoulder blades back and feet planted.

seated-overhead-press-dumbbell.name: Seated Overhead Press (Dumbbell)
cues: Start with the dumbbell at shoulder height, palms forward.
Press straight up until the arms are locked out overhead, ribs down.
Lower under control to the start; no leaning back.

lateral-raise-dumbbell.name: Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
cues: Slight bend in the elbows, dumbbells at the sides.
Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height, leading with the elbows.
Lower slowly; no shrugging or swinging.

standing-lateral-raise-machine.name: Standing Lateral Raise (Machine)
cues: Slight bend in the elbows, weights at the sides.
Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height, leading with the elbows.
Lower slowly; no shrugging or swinging.

front-raise-dumbbell.name: Front Raise (Dumbbell)
cues: Arms hanging in front, slight bend in the elbows.
Raise the weight straight in front to eye height.
Lower slowly without swinging the torso.

bicep-curl-dumbbell.name: Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
cues: Palms forward, elbows pinned at the sides.
Curl by bending only the elbows; upper arms stay still.
Lower all the way to straight arms under control.

hack-squat-machine.name: Hack Squat (Machine)
cues: Shoulders under the pads, back on the sled, feet mid-platform.
Lower until the thighs pass parallel, knees tracking over the toes.
Press back up without locking the knees.

squat-smith-machine.name: Squat (Smith Machine)
cues: Bar on the upper back, hands just outside the shoulders.
Sit down between the hips until the thighs pass parallel, knees out over the toes.
Drive up through the whole foot, chest and hips rising together.

leg-extension-machine.name: Leg Extension (Machine)
cues: Sit back with the knees at the seat edge, pad on the lower shins.
Straighten the knees to lift the pad, squeezing the quads.
Lower slowly.

standing-calf-raise-machine.name: Standing Calf Raise (Machine)
cues: Balls of the feet on the platform, knees straight but not locked.
Rise as high as you can onto the toes and pause.
Lower slowly for a full stretch.

treadmill-incline-walk.name: Treadmill (Incline Walk)
cues: Tall posture, relaxed shoulders.
Natural stride, heel to toe, arms swinging.
Breathe steadily.

incline-bench-press-barbell.name: Incline Bench Press (Barbell)
cues: Medium grip, bar in the heel of the palm, thumbs around the bar.
Lower under control to the lower chest, elbows about 45-60° from the body.
Press back up over the shoulders; shoulder blades pinned, feet planted.

decline-bench-press-barbell.name: Decline Bench Press (Barbell)
cues: Medium grip, bar in the heel of the palm, thumbs around the bar.
Lower under control to the lower chest, elbows about 45-60° from the body.
Press back up over the shoulders; shoulder blades pinned, feet planted.

close-grip-bench-press-barbell.name: Close-Grip Bench Press (Barbell)
cues: Close grip, bar in the heel of the palm, thumbs around the bar.
Lower under control to the lower chest, elbows about 45-60° from the body.
Press back up over the shoulders; shoulder blades pinned, feet planted.

bench-press-dumbbell.name: Bench Press (Dumbbell)
cues: Start with the dumbbells over the shoulders, palms toward your feet.
Lower until the elbows are just below the bench, wrists stacked over the elbows.
Press up and slightly in; keep the shoulder blades back and feet planted.

bench-press-smith-machine.name: Bench Press (Smith Machine)
cues: Medium grip, bar in the heel of the palm, thumbs around the bar.
Lower under control to the lower chest, elbows about 45-60° from the body.
Press back up over the shoulders; shoulder blades pinned, feet planted.

incline-bench-press-smith-machine.name: Incline Bench Press (Smith Machine)
cues: Medium grip, bar in the heel of the palm, thumbs around the bar.
Lower under control to the lower chest, elbows about 45-60° from the body.
Press back up over the shoulders; shoulder blades pinned, feet planted.

chest-press-machine.name: Chest Press (Machine)
cues: Sit tall with the back on the pad and handles at mid-chest.
Press the handles forward until the arms are straight without locking hard.
Return slowly until the hands are beside the chest.

incline-chest-press-machine.name: Incline Chest Press (Machine)
cues: Sit tall with the back on the pad and handles at mid-chest.
Press the handles forward until the arms are straight without locking hard.
Return slowly until the hands are beside the chest.

chest-fly-dumbbell.name: Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
cues: Lie on the bench, dumbbells over the chest, palms facing, elbows softly bent.
Open the arms in a wide arc until the hands are level with the chest.
Squeeze the chest to bring them back together over the chest.

pec-deck-machine.name: Pec Deck (Machine)
cues: Elbows softly bent and fixed, chest up.
Sweep the hands together in front of the chest.
Open slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.

low-to-high-cable-fly.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
cues: Elbows softly bent and fixed, chest up.
Sweep the hands together in front of the chest from low to high.
Open slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.

push-up.name: Push Up
cues: Hands a little wider than the shoulders, fingers forward, body in one straight line.
Lower the chest to just above the floor with elbows about 45° from the body.
Push back up to straight arms without letting the hips sag.

pull-up.name: Pull Up
cues: Hang with a overhand grip.
Pull the chest toward the bar, driving the elbows down to the ribs.
Lower to straight arms under control; no swinging.

chin-up.name: Chin Up
cues: Hang with a palms-toward-you grip.
Pull the chest toward the bar, driving the elbows down to the ribs.
Lower to straight arms under control; no swinging.

assisted-pull-up-machine.name: Assisted Pull Up (Machine)
cues: Hang with a palms-toward-you grip.
Pull the chest toward the bar, driving the elbows down to the ribs.
Lower to straight arms under control; no swinging.

bent-over-row-barbell.name: Bent Over Row (Barbell)
cues: Hinge forward to about 60° with a flat back, knees soft.
Row the weight to the lower ribs, elbows driving back.
Lower to straight arms, keeping the torso still.

one-arm-row-dumbbell.name: One-Arm Row (Dumbbell)
cues: One knee and hand on the bench, back flat, other foot on the floor.
Row the weight to the hip, elbow close to the body.
Lower to a full stretch without twisting the torso.

shrug-dumbbell.name: Shrug (Dumbbell)
cues: Stand tall, arms straight, weight hanging at the sides.
Lift the shoulders straight up toward the ears and pause.
Lower slowly; don't roll the shoulders or bend the elbows.

shrug-barbell.name: Shrug (Barbell)
cues: Stand tall, arms straight, weight hanging at the sides.
Lift the shoulders straight up toward the ears and pause.
Lower slowly; don't roll the shoulders or bend the elbows.

deadlift-barbell.name: Deadlift (Barbell)
cues: Feet hip width, grip just outside the legs.
Brace, push the floor away and stand up, keeping the weight close to the legs.
Squeeze the glutes to finish tall; return with the same flat back.

romanian-deadlift-barbell.name: Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
cues: Overhand grip just outside the thighs, soft knees.
Push the hips back with a flat back; the bar slides down the thighs to about mid-shin.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall; the bar stays over mid-foot.

back-extension.name: Back Extension
cues: Hips on the pad, heels locked under the rollers, body straight.
Hinge down at the hips until the torso is near vertical.
Raise back up to a straight line; don't over-arch.

overhead-press-barbell.name: Overhead Press (Barbell)
cues: Bar on the front of the shoulders, hands just outside them, forearms vertical.
Press straight up, moving the head back to clear the bar.
Lock out with the bar over mid-foot and the ribs down.

lateral-raise-machine.name: Lateral Raise (Machine)
cues: Slight bend in the elbows, weights at the sides.
Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height, leading with the elbows.
Lower slowly; no shrugging or swinging.

front-raise-cable.name: Front Raise (Cable)
cues: Arms hanging in front, slight bend in the elbows.
Raise the weight straight in front to eye height.
Lower slowly without swinging the torso.

bicep-curl-barbell.name: Bicep Curl (Barbell)
cues: Palms facing forward, elbows pinned at the sides.
Curl by bending the elbows; upper arms stay still.
Lower all the way to straight arms under control.

hammer-curl-dumbbell.name: Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
cues: Palms facing each other (hammer grip), elbows pinned at the sides.
Curl by bending the elbows; upper arms stay still.
Lower all the way to straight arms under control.

incline-curl-dumbbell.name: Incline Curl (Dumbbell)
cues: Palms facing forward, elbows pinned at the sides.
Curl by bending the elbows; upper arms stay still.
Lower all the way to straight arms under control.

preacher-curl-machine.name: Preacher Curl (Machine)
cues: Sit tall, armpits on the top of the pad, elbows in line with the machine's pivot.
Curl the handle up until the forearms are vertical; the weights rise.
Lower slowly to almost straight arms.

preacher-curl-ez-bar.name: Preacher Curl (EZ Bar)
cues: Palms facing forward, elbows on the pad.
Curl by bending the elbows; upper arms stay still.
Lower all the way to straight arms under control.

concentration-curl-dumbbell.name: Concentration Curl (Dumbbell)
cues: Palms facing forward, elbows pinned at the sides.
Curl by bending the elbows; upper arms stay still.
Lower all the way to straight arms under control.

wrist-curl-dumbbell.name: Wrist Curl (Dumbbell)
cues: Sit with the forearms on the thighs, palms up, wrists past the knees.
Curl the wrist up as far as it goes; only the wrist moves.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

squat-barbell.name: Squat (Barbell)
cues: Bar on the upper back, hands just outside the shoulders, elbows down and back.
Sit down between the hips until thighs pass parallel, knees out over the toes.
Drive up with the chest and hips rising together; whole foot on the floor.

leg-press-machine.name: Leg Press (Machine)
cues: Back flat on the pad, feet shoulder width on the platform.
Lower the platform until the knees reach about 90°, lower back stays down.
Press back up without locking the knees.

bulgarian-split-squat-dumbbell.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Dumbbell)
cues: Split stance, back foot laces-down on the bench.
Drop the back knee straight down until the front thigh is parallel.
Drive up through the front heel; torso tall.

walking-lunge-dumbbell.name: Walking Lunge (Dumbbell)
cues: Stand tall, weights at the sides.
Step forward and lower until both knees are about 90°.
Push back to standing and switch legs.

goblet-squat-dumbbell.name: Goblet Squat (Dumbbell)
cues: Hold the weight at the chest, elbows under it.
Sit down between the hips until the thighs pass parallel, knees out over the toes.
Drive up through the whole foot, chest and hips rising together.

hip-thrust-barbell.name: Hip Thrust (Barbell)
cues: Upper back on the bench edge, feet flat about hip width, bar over the hips.
Drive the hips up until the body is flat from shoulders to knees, chin tucked.
Squeeze the glutes at the top, then lower under control.

hip-thrust-machine.name: Hip Thrust (Machine)
cues: Upper back on the bench edge, feet flat about hip width.
Drive the hips up until the body is straight from knees to shoulders; chin tucked.
Squeeze the glutes at the top, then lower under control.

cable-pull-through.name: Cable Pull-Through
cues: Feet hip width, grip just outside the legs.
Push the hips back with a flat back, soft knees, until you feel the hamstrings stretch.
Squeeze the glutes to finish tall; return with the same flat back.

glute-kickback-machine.name: Glute Kickback (Machine)
cues: Chest on the pad, one foot on the plate.
Drive the plate back by straightening the hip.
Return slowly.

decline-crunch.name: Decline Crunch
cues: Hook the feet under the pads, lie back on the decline bench.
Curl the shoulders up off the pad, leading with the chest.
Lower slowly.

russian-twist.name: Russian Twist
cues: Sit leaning back with the feet off the floor.
Rotate the torso to touch the weight beside each hip.
Keep the chest up and the movement controlled.

treadmill-run.name: Treadmill Run
cues: Tall posture, relaxed shoulders.
Quick light steps, landing under the hips; arms swing forward and back.
Breathe steadily.

stair-climber.name: Stair Climber
cues: Tall posture, relaxed shoulders.
Natural stride, heel to toe, arms swinging.
Breathe steadily.

decline-bench-press-dumbbell.name: Decline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
cues: Start with the dumbbells over the shoulders, palms toward your feet.
Lower until the elbows are just below the bench, wrists stacked over the elbows.
Press up and slightly in; keep the shoulder blades back and feet planted.

incline-chest-fly-dumbbell.name: Incline Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
cues: Lie on the bench, dumbbells over the chest, palms facing, elbows softly bent.
Open the arms in a wide arc until the hands are level with the chest.
Squeeze the chest to bring them back together over the chest.

chest-fly-cable.name: Chest Fly (Cable)
cues: Elbows softly bent and fixed, chest up.
Sweep the hands together in front of the chest.
Open slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.

pullover-dumbbell.name: Pullover (Dumbbell)
cues: Lie on the bench holding the weight over the chest, elbows slightly bent.
Lower it back behind the head in an arc until you feel the lats stretch.
Pull it back over the chest with straight arms.

bench-dip.name: Bench Dip
cues: Hands on the bench edge behind you, fingers forward, heels on the floor.
Bend the elbows straight back to about 90°, hips close to the bench.
Press back up to straight arms.

triceps-extension-machine.name: Triceps Extension (Machine)
cues: Sit with the upper arms on the pad, elbows in line with the pivot, hands by the head.
Press the handle forward and down until the arms are straight; the weights rise.
Bend back slowly to the start.

triceps-kickback-dumbbell.name: Triceps Kickback (Dumbbell)
cues: Hinge forward, upper arm tucked parallel to the floor.
Straighten the elbow to push the weight back.
Return to 90° at the elbow; the upper arm stays still.

lat-pulldown-neutral-grip.name: Lat Pulldown (Neutral Grip)
cues: Thighs locked under the pad, palms facing each other.
Pull to the upper chest, elbows driving down and back, slight lean back.
Return to straight arms, letting the shoulder blades rise.

pull-up-wide-grip.name: Pull Up (Wide Grip)
cues: Hang with a overhand grip, wider than the shoulders.
Pull the chest toward the bar, driving the elbows down to the ribs.
Lower to straight arms under control; no swinging.

pull-up-neutral-grip.name: Pull Up (Neutral Grip)
cues: Hang with a palms-in grip.
Pull the chest toward the bar, driving the elbows down to the ribs.
Lower to straight arms under control; no swinging.

pull-up-weighted.name: Pull Up (Weighted)
cues: Hang with a overhand grip.
Pull the chest toward the bar, driving the elbows down to the ribs.
Lower to straight arms under control; no swinging.

seated-row-wide-grip-cable.name: Seated Row (Wide Grip, Cable)
cues: Sit tall
Pull the handles to the lower ribs, elbows wide, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Reach forward to straight arms without rounding the lower back.

chest-supported-row-dumbbell.name: Chest-Supported Row (Dumbbell)
cues: Chest on the pad, arms hanging straight.
Row the weight up toward the lower ribs, elbows close beside the body.
Lower to straight arms, letting the shoulder blades spread.

trap-bar-deadlift.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
cues: Feet hip width, neutral grip on the handles.
Brace, push the floor away and stand up, keeping the weight close to the legs.
Squeeze the glutes to finish tall; return with the same flat back.

single-leg-romanian-deadlift-dumbbell.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
cues: Feet hip width, grip just outside the legs.
Push the hips back with a flat back, soft knees, until you feel the hamstrings stretch.
Squeeze the glutes to finish tall; return with the same flat back.

overhead-press-smith-machine.name: Overhead Press (Smith Machine)
cues: Bar on the front of the shoulders, hands just outside them, forearms vertical.
Press straight up until the arms are locked out overhead, ribs down.
Lower under control to the start; no leaning back.

bicep-curl-seated-dumbbell.name: Bicep Curl (Seated, Dumbbell)
cues: Palms facing forward, elbows pinned at the sides.
Curl by bending the elbows; upper arms stay still.
Lower all the way to straight arms under control.

hammer-curl-cable-rope.name: Hammer Curl (Cable Rope)
cues: Palms facing each other (hammer grip), elbows pinned at the sides.
Curl by bending the elbows; upper arms stay still.
Lower all the way to straight arms under control.

preacher-curl-dumbbell.name: Preacher Curl (Dumbbell)
cues: Palms facing forward, elbows on the pad.
Curl by bending the elbows; upper arms stay still.
Lower all the way to straight arms under control.

wrist-curl-barbell.name: Wrist Curl (Barbell)
cues: Sit with the forearms on the thighs, palms up, wrists past the knees.
Curl the wrist up as far as it goes; only the wrist moves.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

squat-dumbbell.name: Squat (Dumbbell)
cues: Weights at the sides, arms long.
Sit down between the hips until the thighs pass parallel, knees out over the toes.
Drive up through the whole foot, chest and hips rising together.

lunge-barbell.name: Lunge (Barbell)
cues: Stand tall, bar on the upper back.
Step forward and lower until both knees are about 90°.
Push back to standing and switch legs.

bodyweight-squat.name: Bodyweight Squat
cues: Arms out in front for balance.
Sit down between the hips until the thighs pass parallel, knees out over the toes.
Drive up through the whole foot, chest and hips rising together.

calf-raise-smith-machine.name: Calf Raise (Smith Machine)
cues: Balls of the feet on the platform, knees straight but not locked.
Rise as high as you can onto the toes and pause.
Lower slowly for a full stretch.

crunch.name: Crunch
cues: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Curl the shoulders off the floor, ribs toward hips.
Lower slowly.

hanging-knee-raise.name: Hanging Knee Raise
cues: Hang from the bar, shoulders engaged.
Lift the knees toward the chest, tilting the pelvis up.
Lower slowly without swinging.

copenhagen-plank.name: Copenhagen Plank
cues: Lie on your side, forearm under the shoulder.
Lift the hips so the body forms a straight line, top leg on the bench.
Hold without letting the hips sag.

pallof-press-cable.name: Pallof Press (Cable)
cues: Stand side-on to the cable, handle held at the chest with both hands.
Press the hands straight out and hold; don't let the cable turn you.
Bring the hands back to the chest.

decline-bench-press-smith-machine.name: Decline Bench Press (Smith Machine)
cues: Medium grip, bar in the heel of the palm, thumbs around the bar.
Lower under control to the lower chest, elbows about 45-60° from the body.
Press back up over the shoulders; shoulder blades pinned, feet planted.

chest-press-cable.name: Chest Press (Cable)
cues: Stand tall in a split stance, core braced.
Press the handles forward until the arms are straight without locking hard.
Return slowly until the hands are beside the chest.

floor-press-barbell.name: Floor Press (Barbell)
cues: Medium grip, bar in the heel of the palm, thumbs around the bar.
Lower under control to the floor, upper arms touching it, elbows about 45-60° from the body.
Press back up over the shoulders; shoulder blades pinned, feet planted.

decline-chest-press-machine.name: Decline Chest Press (Machine)
cues: Sit tall with the back on the pad and handles at mid-chest.
Press the handles forward until the arms are straight without locking hard.
Return slowly until the hands are beside the chest.

incline-push-up.name: Incline Push Up
cues: Hands a little wider than the shoulders on the bench, body in one straight line.
Lower the chest to just above the bench.
Push back up without letting the hips sag.

decline-push-up.name: Decline Push Up
cues: Hands a little wider than the shoulders, body in one straight line.
Lower the chest to just above the floor.
Push back up without letting the hips sag.

diamond-push-up.name: Diamond Push Up
cues: Hands close together, body in one straight line.
Lower the chest to just above the floor.
Push back up without letting the hips sag.

triceps-kickback-cable.name: Triceps Kickback (Cable)
cues: Hinge forward, upper arm tucked parallel to the floor.
Straighten the elbow to push the weight back.
Return to 90° at the elbow; the upper arm stays still.

triceps-pushdown-reverse-grip.name: Triceps Pushdown (Reverse Grip)
cues: Elbows pinned at the sides, slight forward lean.
Push the handle down until the arms are straight.
Return to about 90° at the elbows without the elbows drifting forward.

close-grip-bench-press-smith-machine.name: Close-Grip Bench Press (Smith Machine)
cues: Close grip, bar in the heel of the palm, thumbs around the bar.
Lower under control to the lower chest, elbows about 45-60° from the body.
Press back up over the shoulders; shoulder blades pinned, feet planted.

inverted-row.name: Inverted Row
cues: Hang under the bar with straight arms, body in one line, heels down.
Pull the chest up, elbows close to the ribs, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Lower to straight arms without letting the hips sag.

rack-pull-barbell.name: Rack Pull (Barbell)
cues: Feet hip width, grip just outside the legs.
Brace, push the floor away and stand up, keeping the weight close to the legs.
Squeeze the glutes to finish tall; return with the same flat back.

seated-overhead-press-smith-machine.name: Seated Overhead Press (Smith Machine)
cues: Bar on the front of the shoulders, hands just outside them, forearms vertical.
Press straight up until the arms are locked out overhead, ribs down.
Lower under control to the start; no leaning back.

lateral-raise-seated-dumbbell.name: Lateral Raise (Seated, Dumbbell)
cues: Slight bend in the elbows, weights at the sides.
Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height, leading with the elbows.
Lower slowly; no shrugging or swinging.

upright-row-barbell.name: Upright Row (Barbell)
cues: Overhand grip about shoulder width, arms hanging.
Pull the weight up close to the body, elbows leading, to mid-chest.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

upright-row-dumbbell.name: Upright Row (Dumbbell)
cues: Overhand grip about shoulder width, arms hanging.
Pull the weight up close to the body, elbows leading, to mid-chest.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

incline-hammer-curl-dumbbell.name: Incline Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
cues: Palms facing each other (hammer grip), elbows pinned at the sides.
Curl by bending the elbows; upper arms stay still.
Lower all the way to straight arms under control.

sumo-squat-dumbbell.name: Sumo Squat (Dumbbell)
cues: Hold one weight between the legs with both hands. Wide stance, toes turned out.
Sit down between the hips until the thighs pass parallel, knees out over the toes.
Drive up through the whole foot, chest and hips rising together.

front-squat-smith-machine.name: Front Squat (Smith Machine)
cues: Bar on the front of the shoulders, elbows high.
Sit down between the hips until the thighs pass parallel, knees out over the toes.
Drive up through the whole foot, chest and hips rising together.

leg-press-single-leg.name: Leg Press (Single Leg)
cues: Sit back against the pad, one foot flat on its plate, knee bent near 90°.
Push the plate away until the leg is almost straight.
Let it come back slowly; the other foot rests on its own plate.

reverse-lunge-barbell.name: Reverse Lunge (Barbell)
cues: Stand tall, bar on the upper back.
Step back and lower until both knees are about 90°.
Push back to standing and switch legs.

single-leg-hip-thrust.name: Single Leg Hip Thrust
cues: Upper back on the bench edge, feet flat about hip width, one leg held up.
Drive the hips up until the body is straight from knees to shoulders; chin tucked.
Squeeze the glutes at the top, then lower under control.

glute-bridge-barbell.name: Glute Bridge (Barbell)
cues: Lie on your back, feet flat about hip width.
Drive the hips up until the body is straight from knees to shoulders; chin tucked.
Squeeze the glutes at the top, then lower under control.

glute-bridge.name: Glute Bridge
cues: Lie on your back, feet flat about hip width.
Drive the hips up until the body is straight from knees to shoulders; chin tucked.
Squeeze the glutes at the top, then lower under control.

hip-abduction-cable.name: Hip Abduction (Cable)
cues: Stand tall on one leg, holding the frame for balance.
Lift the working leg out to the side, toes forward.
Return slowly without leaning.

calf-raise-dumbbell-single-leg.name: Calf Raise (Dumbbell, Single Leg)
cues: Balls of the feet on the platform, knees straight but not locked.
Rise as high as you can onto the toes and pause.
Lower slowly for a full stretch.

decline-sit-up.name: Decline Sit Up
cues: Hook the feet under the pads, lie back on the decline bench.
Sit all the way up, leading with the chest.
Lower slowly.

reverse-crunch.name: Reverse Crunch
cues: Lie on your back.
Curl the knees toward the chest, lifting the hips.
Lower slowly.

bicycle-crunch.name: Bicycle Crunch
cues: Lie back, hands behind the head, shoulders off the floor.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee as the other leg straightens.
Switch sides in a smooth pedalling motion.

v-up.name: V Up
cues: Lie on your back.
Lift the arms and legs together to meet over the hips.
Lower slowly.

dead-bug.name: Dead Bug
cues: Lie on your back, lower back pressed into the floor.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Keep breathing; return and switch sides.

bird-dog.name: Bird Dog
cues: On hands and knees, back flat.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are level with the body.
Return and switch sides without rocking.

mountain-climber.name: Mountain Climber
cues: Hands under the shoulders, body in one straight line.
Drive the knees toward the chest one at a time, fast.
Keep the hips level; breathe.

side-bend-dumbbell.name: Side Bend (Dumbbell)
cues: Stand tall, weight in one hand at the side, the other hand on the hip.
Bend straight sideways toward the weight.
Pull back up past upright using the opposite side.

torso-rotation-machine.name: Torso Rotation (Machine)
cues: Sit tall, knees against the pads, hands on the handles.
Rotate the torso to one side using the obliques; hips stay still.
Return through the middle to the other side.

back-extension-machine.name: Back Extension (Machine)
cues: Sit with the upper back against the pad, feet on the platform.
Extend back by straightening the spine and hips.
Return slowly forward.

jump-rope.name: Jump Rope
cues: Elbows close to the sides, turn the rope with the wrists.
Small quick hops on the balls of the feet.
Stay light and rhythmic.

kettlebell-swing.name: Kettlebell Swing
cues: Feet a little wider than the hips, both hands on the handle.
Hike the bell back between the legs with a flat back.
Snap the hips forward to float the bell to chest height.

goblet-squat-kettlebell.name: Goblet Squat (Kettlebell)
cues: Hold the weight at the chest, elbows under it.
Sit down between the hips until the thighs pass parallel, knees out over the toes.
Drive up through the whole foot, chest and hips rising together.

landmine-press.name: Landmine Press

drag-curl-barbell.name: Drag Curl (Barbell)

dead-hang.name: Dead Hang

sissy-squat.name: Sissy Squat

wall-sit.name: Wall Sit

thruster-barbell.name: Thruster (Barbell)

Return slowly.

lat-pulldown-close-grip-cable.name: Lat Pulldown - Close Grip (Cable)
cues: Thighs locked under the pad, overhand grip just outside the shoulders.
Pull to the upper chest, elbows driving down and back, slight lean back.
Return to straight arms, letting the shoulder blades rise.

shoulder-press-machine.name: Shoulder Press (Machine)
cues: Start with the shoulder press machine at shoulder height, palms forward.
Press straight up until the arms are locked out overhead, ribs down.
Lower under control to the start; no leaning back.

upright-row-cable.name: Upright Row (Cable)
cues: Overhand grip about shoulder width, arms hanging.
Pull the weight up close to the body, elbows leading, to mid-chest.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

pendulum-squat-machine.name: Pendulum Squat (Machine)
cues: Shoulders under the pads, back on the sled, feet mid-platform.
Lower until the thighs pass parallel, knees tracking over the toes.
Press back up without locking the knees.

standing-leg-curl-machine.name: Standing Leg Curl (Machine)
cues: Stand on the platform holding the handles, front of the thigh against the knee pad, roller behind the ankle.
Curl the heel up toward the glutes.
Lower slowly.

hanging-leg-raise.name: Hanging Leg Raise
cues: Hang from the bar, shoulders engaged.
Lift the legs to hip height, tilting the pelvis up.
Lower slowly without swinging.

plank.name: Plank
cues: Forearms under the shoulders, body in one straight line.
Squeeze the glutes and brace the abs.
Keep the hips level; breathe.

rowing-machine.name: Rowing Machine
cues: Legs drive first, then lean back slightly, then pull the handle to the lower ribs.
Return: arms, then body, then knees.
Keep a smooth rhythm.

incline-cable-fly.name: Incline Cable Fly
cues: Elbows softly bent and fixed, chest up.
Sweep the hands together in front of the chest.
Open slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.

chest-press-plate-loaded.name: Chest Press (Plate-loaded)
cues: Sit tall with the back on the pad and handles at mid-chest.
Press the handles forward until the arms are straight without locking hard.
Return slowly until the hands are beside the chest.

lat-pulldown-v-bar.name: Lat Pulldown (V-Bar)
cues: Thighs locked under the pad, palms facing each other.
Pull to the upper chest, elbows driving down and back, slight lean back.
Return to straight arms, letting the shoulder blades rise.

high-row-machine.name: High Row (Machine)
cues: Sit with the chest against the pad, arms long on the handles.
Row the handles toward the ribs, elbows driving back, chest staying on the pad.
Lower to straight arms, letting the shoulder blades spread.

low-row-machine.name: Low Row (Machine)
cues: Sit with the chest against the pad, arms long on the handles.
Row the handles toward the ribs, elbows driving back, chest staying on the pad.
Lower to straight arms, letting the shoulder blades spread.

good-morning-barbell.name: Good Morning (Barbell)
cues: Feet hip width, grip just outside the legs.
Push the hips back with a flat back, soft knees, until you feel the hamstrings stretch.
Squeeze the glutes to finish tall; return with the same flat back.

reverse-fly-cable.name: Reverse Fly (Cable)
cues: Torso hinged forward, back flat, arms hanging with soft elbows.
Raise the arms out wide to shoulder height, squeezing the rear shoulders.
Lower slowly; don't shrug or swing.

lying-leg-raise.name: Lying Leg Raise
cues: Lie on your back, legs straight, lower back pressed down.
Raise the legs to vertical with control.
Lower slowly without arching the back.

lying-triceps-extension-dumbbell.name: Lying Triceps Extension (Dumbbell)
cues: Lie on the bench, arms straight up over the shoulders.
Bend only the elbows to lower the weight toward the forehead.
Straighten the arms back up; upper arms stay still.

shrug-smith-machine.name: Shrug (Smith Machine)
cues: Stand tall, arms straight, weight hanging at the sides.
Lift the shoulders straight up toward the ears and pause.
Lower slowly; don't roll the shoulders or bend the elbows.

push-press-barbell.name: Push Press (Barbell)
cues: Bar on the front of the shoulders, hands just outside them, forearms vertical.
Press straight up until the arms are locked out overhead, ribs down.
Lower under control to the start; no leaning back. Dip the knees and drive the weight up with the legs.

lateral-raise-plate-loaded.name: Lateral Raise (Plate-loaded)
cues: Slight bend in the elbows, weights at the sides.
Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height, leading with the elbows.
Lower slowly; no shrugging or swinging.

front-raise-barbell.name: Front Raise (Barbell)
cues: Arms hanging in front, slight bend in the elbows.
Raise the weight straight in front to eye height.
Lower slowly without swinging the torso.

preacher-curl-cable.name: Preacher Curl (Cable)
cues: Palms facing forward, elbows on the pad.
Curl by bending the elbows; upper arms stay still.
Lower all the way to straight arms under control.

overhead-cable-curl.name: Overhead Cable Curl
cues: Palms facing forward, elbows pinned at the sides.
Curl by bending the elbows; upper arms stay still.
Lower all the way to straight arms under control.

reverse-curl-cable.name: Reverse Curl (Cable)
cues: Palms facing back (overhand), elbows pinned at the sides.
Curl by bending the elbows; upper arms stay still.
Lower all the way to straight arms under control.

hip-adduction-cable.name: Hip Adduction (Cable)
cues: Stand tall on one leg, holding the frame for balance.
Sweep the working leg across in front of the other.
Return slowly without leaning.

triceps-dip-plate-loaded-machine.name: Triceps Dip (Plate-loaded Machine)
cues: Sit tall with the back on the pad, handles beside the chest, elbows bent about 90°.
Press the handles down until the arms are straight beside the hips.
Let them rise slowly back to chest height.

leg-curl-plate-loaded.name: Leg Curl (Plate-loaded)
cues: Lie face down, knees just off the pad, pad above the heels.
Curl the heels toward the glutes, hips pressed down.
Lower slowly to straight legs.

y-raise-cable.name: Y Raise (Cable)
cues: Torso hinged forward, back flat, arms hanging with soft elbows.
Raise the arms out wide to shoulder height, squeezing the rear shoulders.
Lower slowly; don't shrug or swing.

curl-smith-machine.name: Curl (Smith Machine)
cues: Palms facing forward, elbows pinned at the sides.
Curl by bending the elbows; upper arms stay still.
Lower all the way to straight arms under control.

reverse-lunge-smith-machine.name: Reverse Lunge (Smith Machine)
cues: Stand tall, bar on the upper back.
Step back and lower until both knees are about 90°.
Push back to standing and switch legs.

calf-raise-barbell.name: Calf Raise (Barbell)
cues: Balls of the feet on the platform, knees straight but not locked.
Rise as high as you can onto the toes and pause.
Lower slowly for a full stretch.

power-clean-barbell.name: Power Clean (Barbell)
cues: Bar over mid-foot, grip just outside the legs, flat back.
Extend hips, knees and ankles explosively, keeping the bar close.
Pull under and catch on the front of the shoulders.

iso-lateral-low-row-plate-loaded.name: Iso-Lateral Low Row (Plate-loaded)
cues: Sit with the chest against the pad, arms long on the handles.
Row the handles toward the ribs, elbows driving back, chest staying on the pad.
Lower to straight arms, letting the shoulder blades spread.

iso-lateral-high-row-plate-loaded.name: Iso-Lateral High Row (Plate-loaded)
cues: Sit with the chest against the pad, arms long on the handles.
Row the handles toward the ribs, elbows driving back, chest staying on the pad.
Lower to straight arms, letting the shoulder blades spread.

overhead-triceps-extension-ez-bar.name: Overhead Triceps Extension (EZ Bar)
cues: Upper arms up beside the head, elbows pointing forward.
Straighten the elbows to press the weight overhead.
Lower behind the head until you feel the triceps stretch; elbows stay in.

triceps-pushdown-straight-bar.name: Triceps Pushdown (Straight Bar)
cues: Elbows pinned at the sides, slight forward lean.
Push the handle down until the arms are straight.
Return to about 90° at the elbows without the elbows drifting forward.

seated-abs-machine.name: Seated Abs (Machine)
cues: Sit tall holding the handles, feet under the pads.
Curl the chest down toward the hips using the abs.
Return slowly.

skull-crusher-ez-bar.name: Skull Crusher (EZ Bar)
cues: Lie on the bench, arms straight up over the shoulders.
Bend only the elbows to lower the weight toward the forehead.
Straighten the arms back up; upper arms stay still.

triceps-pushdown-v-bar.name: Triceps Pushdown (V-Bar)
cues: Elbows pinned at the sides, slight forward lean.
Push the handle down until the arms are straight.
Return to about 90° at the elbows without the elbows drifting forward.

calf-raise-hack-squat.name: Calf Raise (Hack Squat)
cues: Balls of the feet on the platform, knees straight but not locked.
Rise as high as you can onto the toes and pause.
Lower slowly for a full stretch.

cable-crossover.name: Cable Crossover
cues: Elbows softly bent and fixed, chest up.
Sweep the hands together in front of the chest from high to low.
Open slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.

shrug-machine.name: Shrug (Machine)
cues: Stand tall, arms straight, weight hanging at the sides.
Lift the shoulders straight up toward the ears and pause.
Lower slowly; don't roll the shoulders or bend the elbows.

chest-dip.name: Chest Dip
cues: Support yourself on straight arms, shoulders down away from the ears.
Lower until the elbows reach about 90°, leaning the chest forward.
Press back up to straight arms.

stationary-bike.name: Stationary Bike
cues: Seat at hip height, slight bend in the knee at the bottom.
Pedal in smooth circles at a steady pace.
Keep the upper body relaxed.

weighted-dip.name: Weighted Dip
cues: Support yourself on straight arms, shoulders down away from the ears.
Lower until the elbows reach about 90°, body upright for the triceps.
Press back up to straight arms.

triceps-dip.name: Triceps Dip
cues: Support yourself on straight arms, shoulders down away from the ears.
Lower until the elbows reach about 90°, body upright for the triceps.
Press back up to straight arms.

shoulder-press-plate-loaded.name: Shoulder Press (Plate-loaded)
cues: Start with the plate at shoulder height, palms forward.
Press straight up until the arms are locked out overhead, ribs down.
Lower under control to the start; no leaning back.

cable-woodchop.name: Cable Woodchop
cues: Stand side-on, both hands on the handle high, arms long.
Rotate through the torso and pivot the back foot as you pull the handle diagonally down across the body.
Return slowly along the same line.

walking-outdoor.name: Walking (Outdoor)
cues: Tall posture, relaxed shoulders.
Natural stride, heel to toe, arms swinging.
Breathe steadily.

running-outdoor.name: Running (Outdoor)
cues: Tall posture, relaxed shoulders.
Quick light steps, landing under the hips; arms swing forward and back.
Breathe steadily.

cycling-outdoor.name: Cycling (Outdoor)
cues: Seat at hip height, slight bend in the knee at the bottom.
Pedal in smooth circles at a steady pace.
Keep the upper body relaxed.

hyperextension-weighted.name: Hyperextension (Weighted)
cues: Hips on the pad, heels locked under the rollers, body straight.
Hinge down at the hips until the torso is near vertical.
Raise back up to a straight line; don't over-arch.

air-bike.name: Air Bike
cues: Seat at hip height, slight bend in the knee at the bottom.
Pedal in smooth circles at a steady pace.
Keep the upper body relaxed.

svend-press-plate.name: Svend Press (Plate)
cues: Stand tall in a split stance, core braced.
Press the handles forward until the arms are straight without locking hard.
Return slowly until the hands are beside the chest.

step-up-weighted-glute-focus.name: Step Up (Weighted Glute Focus)
cues: Whole foot on the box.
Drive through the top foot to stand on the box.
Return under control without pushing off the bottom foot.

glute-ham-raise.name: Glute-Ham Raise
cues: Thighs on the pad, ankles locked under the rollers, feet on the plate.
From hanging forward, raise the trunk with the glutes and hamstrings, pressing the toes into the plate.
Lower under control.

skull-crusher-dumbbell.name: Skull Crusher (Dumbbell)
cues: Lie on the bench, arms straight up over the shoulders.
Bend only the elbows to lower the weight toward the forehead.
Straighten the arms back up; upper arms stay still.

skull-crusher-cable.name: Skull Crusher (Cable)
cues: Lie on the bench, arms straight up over the shoulders.
Bend only the elbows to lower the weight toward the forehead.
Straighten the arms back up; upper arms stay still.

donkey-kick-cable.name: Donkey Kick (Cable)
cues: Brace the core, on hands and knees.
Drive the working leg back by squeezing the glute.
Return slowly; don't arch the lower back.

flutter-kick.name: Flutter Kick
cues: Lie on your back, legs straight, lower back pressed down.
Raise the legs in small alternating kicks.
Lower slowly without arching the back.

hollow-hold.name: Hollow Hold
cues: Lie on your back, lower back pressed into the floor.
Hold arms overhead and legs low in a banana shape.
Hold the shape.

ab-wheel-rollout.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
cues: Kneel holding the wheel under the shoulders.
Roll forward slowly, keeping the hips in line and the lower back flat.
Pull back with the abs to the start.

ab-wheel-rollout-standing.name: Ab Wheel Rollout (Standing)
cues: Stand, bend over and put the wheel on the floor.
Roll forward slowly, keeping the hips in line and the lower back flat.
Pull back with the abs to the start.

swimming.name: Swimming
cues: Long body line, head in line with the spine.
Pull the water back past the hips, then bring the arm forward again.
Kick steadily from the hips with relaxed, pointed toes.

dragon-flag.name: Dragon Flag
cues: Lie on the bench gripping it behind the head.
Lift the whole body up onto the shoulders in one straight line.
Lower slowly, keeping the body straight.
